gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioblastoma; Recurrent Malignant Glioma; Recurrent WHO Grade II Glioma; Recurrent WHO Grade III Glioma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Relapsed disease: radiographic evidence of recurrence/progression of measurable disease after standard therapy

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Evaluate CAR T cell persistence in the tumor tissue and the location of the CAR T cells with respect to the injection site.
Describe persistence, expansion, and phenotype of endogenous and CLTX-CAR CAR T cells in tumor cyst fluid (TCF), peripheral blood (PB), and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Evaluate CLTX-targeted antigen expression levels on tumor tissue pre and post CAR T cell therapy.

role_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] Chlorotoxin (EQ)-CD28-CD3zeta-CD19t-expressing CAR T-lymphocytes (via ICT/ICV dual delivery)

agents.drug_class_hint: chlorotoxin-targeted CAR T cell therapy (cell therapy)

source_quote.quote: City of Hope (COH) Clinical Pathology confirms matrix metalloproteinase (MMP)2+ tumor expression by immunohistochemistry

coder_notes: Only intervention is a CAR T cell product (excluded type), so no candidate; MMP2 is the CAR target but there is no candidate agent, hence candidate_matched false. Conditions list GBM plus grade II/III glioma; eligibility requires grade IV GBM or progression to GBM. Tumour PK / target engagement coded for CAR T persistence in tumour/CSF and antigen expression pre/post; arms are dose/delivery cohorts, both experimental.
